incident: Production adr-analysis run of 2026-09-15: 21 of 27 drug-safety engine jobs failed in ADR-term normalization, and the capability delivered nothing (specialist_deliverable_not_accepted).
source: Platform audit of 2026-09-26, report I2 section 2.7 and gap list item 1. The auditor called normalize_adr inside the production engine container on the seven-term probe panel below: four were not recognized, and the only candidate offered for bradycardia was urticaria. The built-in table then knew 119 PTs.
limitation: The 21 failing job terms themselves are in the production job records, which this case could not read. Extract them read-only with extractCommand and append any term not listed here to jobTerms, with its expected PT.

reconstructedTerms.note: Not extracted from the jobs: English terms of the kind they sent -- the cardiac and pulmonary events a run on brief adr-001 (osimertinib) names, written the way a model writes them (title case, singular, clinical rather than MedDRA wording). Each expected value is a FAERS term.

briefTerms.note: The Chinese event terms the four adr-analysis briefs (OpenScience/evals/adr-analysis/briefs.json) hand the run, split on 、 the way a run splits them. 心血管死亡 is deliberately absent: MedDRA has no such PT, and mapping it is the model's reading, confirmed or refused like any other.
